$comment: Generated distribution artifact. Embedded resources preserve their canonical $id values; do not edit this file by hand.

core__capability.title: Capability
core__capability.description: A named, versioned unit of executable functionality registered in agent-kernel. Capabilities have stable IDs and declared input/output schema references.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this capability. Should be namespaced (e.g., 'org.myapp.search_docs').

description.description: Concise description of what this capability does and when to use it.

input_schema_ref.description: Optional URI reference to the JSON Schema describing valid inputs for this capability.

output_schema_ref.description: Optional URI reference to the JSON Schema describing the output Frame content for this capability.

tags.description: Optional tags for categorization and discovery.

core__capability_token.title: CapabilityToken
core__capability_token.description: A signed, scoped authorization credential that grants the bearer permission to invoke specific capabilities. Issued by agent-kernel. Must be scoped and have an expiry or single-use flag.

principal.description: Identity of the principal (user, agent, or service) this token was issued to.

scope.description: List of capability IDs this token authorizes. Must not be empty; unbounded scope is not permitted.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this token was issued.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp. Null only if single_use is true.

single_use.description: If true, this token is invalidated after a single successful authorization. expires_at may be null for single-use tokens.

issuer.description: Optional identifier of the agent-kernel instance that issued this token.

core__choice_card.title: ChoiceCard
core__choice_card.description: A curated, bounded set of SelectableItem objects presented to the LLM as a structured menu. The LLM selects from this card rather than an unbounded tool list.

items.description: Ordered list of selectable options. Should contain 3–7 items for practical LLM selection.

context_hint.description: Optional guidance for the LLM about how to interpret this card (e.g., 'Select the most appropriate data retrieval action').

core__frame.title: Frame
core__frame.description: A safe, filtered view of a tool execution result. Produced by the agent-kernel firewall. This is what contextweaver and the LLM see. Never contains raw tool output.

capability_id.description: The capability that produced this Frame.

summary.description: Human-readable, LLM-safe summary of the execution result. Must not contain raw tool output.

structured_data.description: Optional structured subset of the result that has been reviewed and approved for LLM consumption. Must be firewall-filtered.

handle_refs.description: List of Handle IDs referencing the full raw artifacts. Handles require authorization to resolve.

redaction_notes.description: Optional description of what was redacted or filtered from the raw output.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this Frame was created by the firewall.

core__handle.title: Handle
core__handle.description: An opaque, access-controlled reference to a raw artifact produced by a tool execution. The actual content is stored in the HandleStore and is not included here. Resolution requires authorization.

handle_id.description: Unique identifier for this Handle. Must not be sufficient to access the artifact without authorization.

capability_id.description: The capability that produced the artifact this Handle references.

artifact_type.description: MIME type or semantic type of the stored artifact (e.g., 'application/json', 'text/plain', 'image/png').

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this Handle was created.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp. Null if the artifact does not expire.

access_policy.description: Optional reference to the access policy or policy ID governing who can resolve this Handle.

byte_size.description: Optional size of the artifact in bytes, for capacity planning.

core__policy_decision.title: PolicyDecision
core__policy_decision.description: The authorization verdict produced by agent-kernel's policy engine for a capability invocation request.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy decision. Used to correlate with TraceEvents.

capability_id.description: The capability ID that was evaluated.

principal.description: The principal whose authorization was evaluated.

token_id.description: The CapabilityToken ID used in this evaluation, if any.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the decision. Recommended for deny decisions.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this decision was made.

core__routing_decision.title: RoutingDecision
core__routing_decision.description: The output of the contextweaver routing phase. Contains one or more ChoiceCards and the selected item once the LLM has responded.

id.description: Unique identifier for this routing decision.

choice_cards.description: One or more ChoiceCards presented during this routing cycle.

selected_item_id.description: The ID of the SelectableItem chosen by the LLM. Null if the LLM response is still pending.

selected_card_id.description: The ID of the ChoiceCard that contained the selected item. Null if no selection has been made.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this routing decision was created.

context_summary.description: Optional brief summary of the context that drove this routing decision. For debugging and audit purposes.

core__selectable_item.title: SelectableItem
core__selectable_item.description: A single option that can be presented to an LLM for selection within a ChoiceCard. Represents one possible action, tool, or capability.

id.description: Unique identifier for this item within its ChoiceCard.

label.description: Short human-readable label. Safe to include in an LLM prompt.

description.description: Concise description of what this item does. Must not include raw tool schema details.

capability_id.description: Optional reference to the Capability this item maps to. Used by agent-kernel to resolve the execution target.

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary key-value metadata for implementation-specific use.

core__trace_event.title: TraceEvent
core__trace_event.description: An immutable audit log entry recording a single significant event in the execution lifecycle. Produced by agent-kernel.

event_type.description: Core event types. Adding new types requires a spec update.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this event occurred.

capability_id.description: The capability involved in this event, if applicable.

principal.description: The principal involved in this event, if applicable.

decision_id.description: The PolicyDecision ID associated with this event, if applicable.

frame_id.description: The Frame ID associated with this event, if applicable.

handle_id.description: The Handle ID associated with this event, if applicable.

outcome.description: Optional high-level outcome of the event.

error_message.description: Error message if the event represents a failure.

extended__artifact_safety_gate_request.title: ArtifactSafetyGateRequest
extended__artifact_safety_gate_request.description: Extended. Inputs to an optional artifact safety gate run that validates agent-produced code/files before a high-impact action. Implementation-neutral: it does not name a specific scanner or rule set.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this gate request.

repository_root.description: Root of the repository or workspace being checked.

artifact_paths.description: Paths of the artifacts to check (code, config, docs, manifests).

diff_scope.description: Optional diff scope, e.g. a git ref range, to bound what is checked.

policy_level.description: Producer-defined policy strictness, e.g. standard, strict.

capability_id.description: Optional Capability ID this gate maps to in agent-kernel.

extended__artifact_safety_report.title: ArtifactSafetyReport
extended__artifact_safety_report.description: Extended. Output of an artifact safety gate run. The mode field distinguishes an advisory check from a blocking gate; decision is the pass/fail verdict; findings carry severity, message, an optional stable fingerprint, and a remediation hint.

gate_id.description: Identifier of the gate/check that produced this report.

decision.description: Pass/fail verdict for the checked artifacts.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the report was produced.

mode.description: Whether the gate is advisory (informational) or blocking (must pass before the action).

request_id.description: Optional ArtifactSafetyGateRequest ID this report answers.

target_ref.description: Optional reference to what was checked (e.g. a commit or diff range).

findings.description: Individual findings produced by the gate.

fingerprint.description: Optional stable fingerprint for deduplication across runs.

extended__capability_token_signature.title: CapabilityTokenSignature
extended__capability_token_signature.description: Extended. A detached signature over a JCS-canonicalized (RFC 8785) CapabilityToken payload. Attached to the token under the namespaced extension key `x_weaver_signature`. Verifiers MUST reject signatures whose `alg` or `canonicalization` is not in the published registry. See docs/SIGNING.md and docs/adr/001-capability-token-signing.md.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. Must be one of the algorithms in the published registry (docs/SIGNING.md). Verifiers MUST reject unknown algorithms.

kid.description: Key identifier. Opaque to the spec; resolves against the verifier's keyring.

sig.description: Base64url-encoded signature bytes (RFC 4648 §5, no padding). For ed25519 this is 64 bytes (86 base64url chars). For es256 this is the IEEE P1363 concatenated (r||s) form, 64 bytes (86 base64url chars). The schema enforces the 86-char length; verifiers MUST still decode and validate cryptographically per docs/SIGNING.md.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization scheme applied to the token payload before signing. JCS = JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785). The `x_weaver_signature` field itself is excluded from the canonical form before hashing.

signed_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp at which the signature was produced. Informational; verification does not depend on it.

extended__compiled_flow.title: CompiledFlow
extended__compiled_flow.description: Extended. A compiled flow (e.g. a ChainWeaver flow) exposed as a Weaver ecosystem item that can be routed to and executed like a capability. References (does not inline) its input/output schemas, lists the capability IDs it depends on internally, and carries sensitivity/side-effect metadata derived from those tools. A pre-compiled flow does not bypass execution authorization: a flow step that invokes a tool still goes through the kernel authorization/audit path (invariant I-07). See docs/EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.md.

flow_id.description: Stable identifier for the compiled flow.

version.description: Optional flow version (useful for versioned ChainWeaver flows).

description.description: Optional short description of what the flow does.

input_schema_ref.description: Optional reference (URI or registry key) to the flow's input schema. The schema is referenced, not inlined, to avoid context bloat.

output_schema_ref.description: Optional reference (URI or registry key) to the flow's output schema.

tool_dependencies.description: Capability IDs the flow invokes internally. Used to derive sensitivity and side-effect metadata and to plan authorization.

sensitivity.description: Optional sensitivity level, typically derived from the most sensitive tool the flow depends on. One of the shared artifact sensitivity levels.

side_effects.description: Optional side-effect markers derived from the flow's tools (e.g. `external_email`, `data_write`). Free-form; namespace project-specific values.

requires_authorization.description: Whether executing this flow requires authorization through the execution/policy layer. Defaults to true; a pre-compiled flow does not bypass the kernel authorization path (invariant I-07).

metadata.description: Implementation-specific extension bag. Namespace project-specific keys to avoid collisions.

extended__conformance_result.title: ConformanceResult
extended__conformance_result.description: Extended. The machine-readable result emitted by the conformance runner (conformance/run.py). It is build-time CI tooling output, not a Weaver runtime contract, but it is a stable inter-repo interchange shape: the self-certification badge (docs/SELF_CERTIFICATION.md) and the public scoreboard (docs/SCOREBOARD.md) consume it, so schematizing it keeps producers and consumers from drifting. See docs/CONFORMANCE.md.

result_version.description: Version of this result format. Bumped only on an intentional shape change.

contract_version.description: The weaver-spec CONTRACT_VERSION the run was performed against.

mode.description: `corpus` when the built-in corpus was run; `bundle` when a single external TraceBundle was checked.

target.description: The bundle path/URL in `bundle` mode; null in `corpus` mode.

status.description: Overall verdict: `pass` iff no checks failed.

failures.description: Count of failed checks (0 iff status is `pass`).

failure_detail.description: Human-readable failure messages (empty when status is `pass`).

failure_records.description: Structured, machine-mappable view of each failure (#145): an agent can map a failure to the offending fixture/field without parsing the human strings. Empty when status is `pass`.

message.description: The same human-readable message as the matching `failure_detail` entry.

payload.description: Repo-relative fixture path or bundle id the failure concerns, when applicable.

schema.description: Schema stem the check validated against, when applicable.

keyword.description: Declared/observed JSON Schema keyword for a schema-level failure, when applicable.

path.description: Location within the payload the failure concerns, when applicable.

invariant_id.description: Invariant id or named check for an invariant-level failure, when applicable.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the result was produced. Used by the freshness policy (docs/SELF_CERTIFICATION.md).

runner.description: Identifier of the tool that produced the result.

extended__evaluation_artifact.title: EvaluationArtifact
extended__evaluation_artifact.description: Extended. A statistical / offline model-evaluation report carried with explicit semantics so agents cannot misuse a headline score. The support_state and recommendation_kind fields encode that a high-risk evaluation is not deployment evidence.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation artifact.

producer.description: The system that produced the evaluation (e.g. skdr-eval).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the evaluation was produced.

target_estimand.description: What is being estimated (e.g. the policy value under a target distribution).

candidate_policy.description: Identifier of the candidate policy being evaluated.

support_state.description: Overall support/diagnostic state. high_risk means the evidence cannot back a deploy decision.

support_diagnostics.description: Diagnostics behind the support_state (overlap, effective sample size).

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level governing how the report may be surfaced.

recommendation_kind.description: Machine-readable recommendation. 'deploy' is not permitted when support_state is 'high_risk'.

provenance.description: Optional structured provenance (dataset, code version, run id).

extended__execution_candidate.title: ExecutionCandidate
extended__execution_candidate.description: Extended. Something that can be selected for execution: a tool, flow, capability, agent, or workflow. Implementation-neutral identifier-plus-metadata shape used by the selection ↔ execution boundary contracts. When candidate_type is `flow` the candidate may carry a `compiled_flow` detail. See docs/EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.md.

candidate_id.description: Stable identifier for the selected item.

candidate_type.description: The kind of item selected. A runtime is not required to support every kind.

version.description: Optional version, useful for versioned flows and tools.

compiled_flow.description: Optional CompiledFlow detail. Only valid when candidate_type is `flow`.

metadata.description: Implementation-specific extension bag. Namespace project-specific keys to avoid collisions.

extended__execution_feedback.title: ExecutionFeedback
extended__execution_feedback.description: Extended. The observed outcome of executing (or attempting to execute) a selected candidate. Links back to the originating decision and candidate so a router or evaluator can correlate recommendation, execution, and result. Sending feedback is optional — a deterministic router need not consume it. See docs/EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.md.

decision_id.description: Links feedback to the originating ExecutionRoutingDecision.

candidate_id.description: Links feedback to the selected ExecutionCandidate.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the feedback was created.

cost.description: Optional structured cost payload (e.g. tokens or USD saved/spent).

error_type.description: Optional normalized error class when success is false.

trace_ref.description: Reference to the execution trace, e.g. a ChainWeaver `chainweaver:trace_id:abc123`.

execution_summary.description: Optional compact summary of the execution result.

metadata.description: Implementation-specific extension bag. Namespace project-specific keys to avoid collisions.

extended__execution_routing_decision.title: ExecutionRoutingDecision
extended__execution_routing_decision.description: Extended. A router's advisory recommendation of an ExecutionCandidate, implementation-neutral with respect to the routing algorithm. Advisory by default: it does NOT grant execution rights — the execution/policy layer still records a PolicyDecision and emits a TraceEvent before running the candidate (invariants I-02, I-07). Distinct from the Core RoutingDecision (the contextweaver ChoiceCard wrapper). See docs/EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.md.

decision_id.description: Stable ID correlating this decision with downstream execution traces and ExecutionFeedback.

fallback_candidates.description: Ordered list of alternative candidates the runtime may fall back to.

constraints.description: Relevant constraints used by the router, such as cost, latency, policy, or user context.

policy_context_ref.description: Optional reference to the policy/auth context the router considered. Advisory only — does not grant authorization.

trace_ref.description: Optional reference to router-side trace/observability data, e.g. `router:trace:abc123`.

created_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was produced.

metadata.description: Implementation-specific extension bag. Namespace project-specific keys to avoid collisions.

extended__extended_frame_metadata.title: ExtendedFrameMetadata
extended__extended_frame_metadata.description: Extended. Optional enriched metadata for a Frame, beyond the Core contract: redaction policy, telemetry hint, schema fingerprint, confidence score, and source capability version.

redaction_policy.description: Optional embedded RedactionPolicy describing how the Frame was redacted.

schema_fingerprint.description: Optional SchemaFingerprint identifying the schema the Frame's body validates against.

confidence_score.description: Optional confidence score in [0.0, 1.0] for the upstream capability's result.

source_capability_version.description: Optional version of the capability that produced the Frame.

extra.description: Implementation-specific extension bag. Namespace project-specific keys to avoid collisions.

extended__extended_selectable_item_metad.title: ExtendedSelectableItemMetadata
extended__extended_selectable_item_metad.description: Extended. Optional UI and risk hints for a SelectableItem: a UI hint, a risk assessment, an estimated duration, and a confirmation requirement.

ui_hint.description: Optional UIHint guiding how the item should be rendered.

risk_assessment.description: Optional RiskAssessment for the selectable item.

estimated_duration_ms.description: Optional estimated execution duration in milliseconds.

requires_confirmation.description: If true, the UI must obtain explicit user confirmation before invoking the item.

extra.description: Implementation-specific extension bag. Namespace project-specific keys to avoid collisions.

extended__failure_case_artifact.title: FailureCaseArtifact
extended__failure_case_artifact.description: Extended. A small, language-neutral record of a replayable failure discovered by fuzzing, property-based testing, replay, or trace analysis. It captures which property/invariant failed, what is needed to reproduce it (seed, generator config, trace reference), whether it was minimized, and its lifecycle status. It references large artifacts (traces) rather than inlining them. A FailureCaseArtifact is reproducible evidence, NOT proof of a bug by itself; triage decides whether a real defect exists. Distinct from a TraceBundle (which inlines a full audit chain) and from a ReviewArtifact (a generic review/trace interchange shape). See docs/ARTIFACT_CONTRACTS.md.

failure_case_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this failure case.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the failure case was captured.

source_project.description: Project that discovered/produced this failure case (e.g. ChainWeaver, agent-kernel, contextweaver, lessonweaver).

property_name.description: Machine-readable name of the property or invariant that failed (e.g. `I-02-policy-decision-has-trace-event`, `flow_is_idempotent`).

status.description: Lifecycle state. `candidate` = newly discovered / under review; `regression` = promoted into a regression test; `ignored` = triaged as not actionable; `fixed` = the underlying defect has been resolved.

property_description.description: Optional human-readable description of the property/invariant and how it was violated.

seed.description: Optional generator/fuzzer seed needed to reproduce the case. A string to stay language-neutral across arbitrarily large seeds.

generator_config.description: Optional generator/fuzzer configuration needed to reproduce the case (e.g. strategy, size bounds, framework version). Namespace project-specific keys.

trace_ref.description: Optional reference to where the captured trace lives (e.g. `chainweaver:trace_id:abc123`). Replayable cases should set this; manually captured cases may rely on `evidence_refs` instead.

minimized.description: Whether the case has been minimized/shrunk to a smaller reproducer.

minimized_from_ref.description: Optional reference to the original, un-minimized failure case this was reduced from.

expected_failure_mode.description: Optional description of how the failure manifests when replayed (e.g. `raises TimeoutError`, `frame contains raw_output marker`).

evidence_refs.description: References to supporting evidence (traces, logs, payloads, TraceBundles).

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of the failure case (a reproducer may embed sensitive inputs).

provenance.description: Optional structured record of how/why the artifact was derived.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Namespace project-specific keys.

extended__lesson_card.title: LessonCard
extended__lesson_card.description: Extended. A reusable lesson derived from traces and approved for reuse. Not a raw trace, raw memory, or generic prompt fragment. The lifecycle_state gates activation: a lesson should pass review before becoming active.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the lesson was created.

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle state; activation requires passing through review.

scope.description: Optional reuse scope, e.g. repo, team, org, global.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level governing how the lesson may be surfaced.

applicability.description: Conditions or tags describing when the lesson applies.

source_refs.description: References to the traces/memory the lesson was derived from (provenance).

extended__memory_artifact.title: MemoryArtifact
extended__memory_artifact.description: Extended. A durable or semi-durable agent memory record, distinct from transient conversation context, raw tool output, and traces. Carries its own sensitivity and provenance because memory content may be sensitive.

memory_id.description: Unique identifier for this memory record.

memory_type.description: Producer-defined kind of memory, e.g. preference, repo_convention, fact.

content.description: The memory content, in a representation safe to store and reuse.

source.description: Where this memory came from (provenance origin).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the memory was first recorded.

updated_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.

scope.description: Optional reuse scope, e.g. session, user, org, global.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level governing how the memory may be surfaced.

confidence.description: Optional confidence in the memory's accuracy (typically 0.0-1.0).

dependency_refs.description: References to other artifacts this memory depends on.

provenance.description: Optional structured provenance (how/why the memory was derived).

extended__otel_trace_mapping.title: OtelTraceMapping
extended__otel_trace_mapping.description: Extended. Mapping of a Weaver TraceEvent onto an OpenTelemetry span — carries the OTel trace/span identifiers and the GenAI semantic-convention attributes that downstream observability tools consume. The full field-by-field mapping is documented in docs/OTEL_MAPPING.md, pinned to the OTel semconv snapshot referenced there.

trace_id.description: OTel trace identifier. 32 lowercase hex characters per the W3C Trace Context (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/#trace-id).

span_id.description: OTel span identifier. 16 lowercase hex characters per the W3C Trace Context (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/#parent-id).

gen_ai_operation_name.description: Value for the OTel attribute `gen_ai.operation.name` (e.g. `chat`, `text_completion`, `embeddings`, `agent.invoke_agent`, `execute_tool`). See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/.

gen_ai_agent_id.description: Value for the OTel attribute `gen_ai.agent.id`. Stable identifier of the agent or capability owner.

gen_ai_agent_name.description: Value for the OTel attribute `gen_ai.agent.name`. Human-readable name of the agent.

gen_ai_tool_name.description: Value for the OTel attribute `gen_ai.tool.name`. Derived from TraceEvent.capability_id by the mapping in docs/OTEL_MAPPING.md.

gen_ai_system.description: Value for the OTel attribute `gen_ai.system`. Identifies the AI system that produced the event (e.g. `anthropic`, `openai`, `weaver`).

parent_span_id.description: Optional parent span ID for nested operations. Same format as span_id.

semconv_version.description: OTel semantic-conventions snapshot the producer mapped against. Mirrors the `semconv_version` value pinned at the top of docs/OTEL_MAPPING.md.

extended__redaction_policy.title: RedactionPolicy
extended__redaction_policy.description: Extended. Describes the redaction rules applied by the firewall when producing a Frame. Identifies which fields were redacted or truncated and whether PII was detected.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier of the redaction policy that produced this record.

redacted_fields.description: Field paths whose values were redacted (removed or masked).

truncated_fields.description: Field paths whose values were truncated to a length bound.

redaction_reason.description: Short human-readable reason the policy was applied.

pii_detected.description: True if any PII-class data was detected in the payload.

pii_types.description: Categories of PII that were detected (e.g., person_name, credential).

extended__review_artifact.title: ReviewArtifact
extended__review_artifact.description: Extended. A minimal, language-neutral interchange shape for trace/review artifacts exchanged between Weaver-stack projects (context build records, execution records, policy decisions, review notes, safety reports). An interchange shape, not a storage system.

artifact_type.description: Producer-defined kind of artifact, e.g. context_build, execution_record, policy_decision, review_note, safety_report.

source_project.description: Project that produced this artifact (e.g. contextweaver, agent-kernel, lessonweaver).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the artifact was created.

subject_ref.description: Optional reference to the subject the artifact is about (e.g. a flow, capability, or commit).

evidence_refs.description: References to supporting evidence (traces, payloads, logs).

decision_refs.description: References to decisions associated with this artifact (e.g. PolicyDecision IDs).

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Namespace project-specific keys.

extended__risk_assessment.title: RiskAssessment
extended__risk_assessment.description: Extended. Optional risk metadata for a capability invocation. Encodes the assessed risk level, reasons, whether human approval is required, and any mitigations in place.

risk_level.description: Assessed risk class. Mirrors RiskAssessment._VALID_LEVELS in extended.py.

risk_reasons.description: Short human-readable reasons that produced this risk level.

requires_human_approval.description: If true, execution should not proceed without approval by the principal named in approval_principal.

approval_principal.description: Optional identifier of the principal expected to approve.

mitigations.description: Mitigations in place that reduce the risk (e.g., sandboxed execution, dry-run available).

extended__schema_fingerprint.title: SchemaFingerprint
extended__schema_fingerprint.description: Extended. Records the schema version and content hash for a contract payload, enabling schema-evolution and compatibility checking across producers and consumers.

schema_id.description: The $id URI of the schema this fingerprint refers to.

schema_version.description: Semver version of the schema, matching CONTRACT_VERSION at the time of emission.

content_hash.description: Optional content hash of the payload (e.g., SHA-256 hex of canonical JSON).

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used to compute content_hash. Defaults to sha256.

extended__session_handoff.title: SessionHandoff
extended__session_handoff.description: Extended. A compact continuity pack carried between agent sessions. Summarizes the state needed to resume work and references (does not inline) durable memory.

from_session_id.description: Identifier of the session being handed off from.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the handoff was created.

summary.description: Compact continuity summary of the session state.

to_session_id.description: Optional identifier of the resuming session, if already known.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level governing how the handoff may be surfaced.

open_threads.description: Unresolved threads or follow-ups to carry into the next session.

memory_refs.description: References to MemoryArtifact IDs relevant to continuity.

extended__skill_card.title: SkillCard
extended__skill_card.description: Extended. A reusable procedure/skill derived from traces and approved for reuse. The lifecycle_state gates activation; steps and preconditions describe how and when to apply the skill.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the skill was created.

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle state; activation requires passing through review.

steps.description: Ordered steps describing how to apply the skill.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold before applying the skill.

scope.description: Optional reuse scope, e.g. repo, team, org, global.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level governing how the skill may be surfaced.

source_refs.description: References to the traces/memory the skill was derived from (provenance).

extended__telemetry_hint.title: TelemetryHint
extended__telemetry_hint.description: Extended. Optional telemetry metadata that can be attached to any event or contract for observability enrichment. All fields are optional; an empty object is valid.

trace_id.description: Optional distributed-trace identifier. Free-form; commonly a W3C traceparent trace-id or vendor-specific string.

span_id.description: Optional span identifier within the trace.

baggage.description: Optional key/value baggage propagated alongside the trace. Values must be strings.

extended__trace_bundle.title: TraceBundle
extended__trace_bundle.description: Extended. A tamper-evident audit-chain envelope that gathers one end-to-end request's Core artifacts into a single document: the RoutingDecision, every PolicyDecision, every Frame, every Handle, and every TraceEvent. The bundle is canonicalized (RFC 8785 JCS) so it can be hashed and, optionally, signed with the same detached-signature shape as a CapabilityToken (CapabilityTokenSignature). It does not redefine any invariant: Frames remain free of raw output (I-01) and each PolicyDecision is still expected to have a matching TraceEvent (I-02). Distinct from a FailureCaseArtifact (which references rather than inlines a trace). See docs/TRACE_BUNDLE.md.

routing_decision.description: The Core RoutingDecision that opened this request's audit chain.

policy_decisions.description: Every PolicyDecision recorded for this request. May be empty only if no capability was authorized; each entry should have a matching TraceEvent (invariant I-02).

frames.description: Every safe-to-display Frame produced during this request. Frames never carry raw output (invariant I-01).

handles.description: Every opaque Handle referenced by the Frames in this bundle.

trace_events.description: The append-only TraceEvents for this request, in emission order.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization scheme applied to the bundle before hashing/signing. JCS = JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785). The `signature` field itself is excluded from the canonical form before hashing.

signature.description: Optional detached signature over the JCS-canonicalized bundle (the same signature shape used for CapabilityTokens). When absent, the bundle is unsigned; producers MUST NOT describe an unsigned bundle as signed.

created_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of when the bundle was assembled.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Namespace project-specific keys.

extended__ui_hint.title: UIHint
extended__ui_hint.description: Extended. Optional rendering hints for UI layers that display ChoiceCards or SelectableItems. All fields are optional; an empty object is valid.

priority.description: Optional sort/priority order for rendering. Higher means more prominent.

group.description: Optional group identifier for clustering related items in the UI.

disabled.description: If true, the UI should render the item as disabled.
